title: Define the global of an event handler's event listener
body: Define the global of an event handler's event listener DOM gets the global of an event listener to set window.event, to skip the listener when that global is not fully active, and to report an exception. For an event handler that would be the callback created in "activate an event handler", whose realm was left unspecified. Override DOM's "get the global" to return the realm of the function the event handler is set to, falling back to the realm an internal raw uncompiled handler would be compiled in, which is where it lands once compiled.
